story:
Ethan ran three laps around the playground before class, because today was Superhero Reading Day. He had brought his bright red cape, but when he reached inside his backpack, it was gone. [emotion:QT/surprised] [emotion:QT/sad] Ethan felt hollow, like a secret base with nothing inside. [gesture:think] He sat down on the rough wooden bench, thinking he had probably left the cape on the chair near the classroom door.

"I think it might be back there," said Rohan, who wore a yellow cape and had noticed Ethan searching. "I'll go with you, because we have a few minutes before the bell rings."

Together, they retraced their steps through the busy hallway. Ethan spotted the bright red fabric tucked behind the classroom door, exactly where he had stopped to tie his shoelace. [emotion:QT/happy] [emotion:QT/happy] "You found it!" Rohan cheered. [gesture:emotions/hoora] Ethan laughed and pulled the cape over his shoulders. [emotion:QT/happy] [gesture:clapping] Both friends ran back outside while other children cheered, and the rescue mission felt completely real.

questions.correct_answer: A friend helped Ethan find his lost superhero cape
wrong_answers: Ethan raced three friends around the playground
Ethan made a secret base before class

wrong_answers: Inside Ethan's backpack on the bench
On the rough wooden bench outside

questions.correct_answer: He ran three laps around the playground
wrong_answers: He cheered with the other children outside
He tied his shoelace near the classroom door

questions.question: Why do you think Ethan felt hollow, like a secret base with nothing inside, when he reached into his backpack?
questions.correct_answer: Because his special cape was missing on Superhero Reading Day
wrong_answers: Because Rohan had a yellow cape and Ethan was jealous
Because he was too tired after running three laps

questions.question: What do you think would have happened if Rohan had not offered to go with Ethan through the busy hallway?
questions.correct_answer: Ethan might not have found his cape in time
wrong_answers: Ethan would have found three more capes behind the door
Rohan would have given Ethan his yellow cape to wear

questions.question: Why was it a good idea for Ethan to let Rohan help him look for the cape?
questions.correct_answer: Asking a friend for help means you find answers faster together.
wrong_answers: Asking a friend for help means you never have to solve problems on your own.
Asking a friend for help means your friend will always know exactly where things are.

questions.question: What did Rohan show us by what he did when Ethan was searching his backpack?
questions.correct_answer: Being a good friend means noticing when someone needs support.
wrong_answers: Being a good friend means always wearing matching costumes on special days.
Being a good friend means reminding others to check their backpacks before leaving home.

questions.question: What is one lesson from this story about Ethan and Rohan searching the hallway together?
questions.correct_answer: Working as a team makes every challenge feel smaller.
wrong_answers: Working as a team means one person does the searching while the other one waits.
Working as a team is only helpful when you are playing a game or doing a sport.
